```
- Send I-9 secure upload link (ID photos)
- Resend Checkr invite if no completion in 24h
```

Sophie (People Ops): Please have W-4 + state form + I-9 done before Monday EOD. Benefits enrollment we open on day 1 but they have 30 days to complete.
Omar (IT): Sam — can you DM me your phone and personal email? I'll set up Okta and schedule remote setup call (15 min) on Monday at 8:45am.
Sam L: DMed you @Omar. Also I didn't get a Checkr email yet, could you resend?
Julia K: Resent Checkr invite to sam.l.personal@gmail.com just now. If it lands in spam, check that folder.
hr-bot: Checkr status for Sam L: invite_sent -> link_resent (2024-04-30 17:03)

Matt R: Awesome, thanks all. :thumbsup:
